top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 chain from proglucagon processing and insulinotropic action (Holst, Drucker) to long-acting agonists with randomized outcome evidence is original, independently confirmed and mature. Drucker, Holst and Knudsen give a citation that runs from physiology to durable medicines and rests on a documented record, with no dependence on the unresolved Mojsov-Habener priority question. P001 is a close second and shares the same scientific core; any award is far better than none.
